newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks lower in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks lower in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks were lower in early morning trade on Thursday, as uncertainty over the economy continued to hit sentiment, brokers said.
They said the Nikkei average's next support point would be 18,000.
The benchmark Nikkei 225 average was down 187.37 points or one percent at 18,493.01 by 0012 GMT. Its March futures were 150 points lower at 18,570.
